StripView_Widget_Search_IsVisible.note: A focused rail only, not the preview: the preview keeps Strip's details positions, clear of the keypad.

search_preview_{index}.note: Reads the rail's probe (prb_search_preview), so readers test one flag, not the chain; only controls after the probe read it, the probe reads its mirror.

search_preview_live_{index}.note: The input has focus and this is the first rail with items; the probe (prb_search_preview) adds the reload rule.

search_prior_clear_{index}.note: No rail before this one has results.

search_rails_onprevious.note: Search's scroll latch triggers (User_Scroll_Delay): the focused rail's moves only, so a cursor reset of an unfocused rail never hides the preview's art.

search_rails_updating.note: A key press reloads every rail: a rail still loading takes focus even if it ends empty, so the input waits for them.

search_container_switching.note: The focused rail was reached less than 0.5x ago (its latch, search_latches).
